full_text:
Nathaniel Jackson
Preserved Primary Document • jacksonn.htm
Nathaniel Jackson was the son of  Wesley Jackson  and his wife, Elizabeth. He was born probably  in Northwest Fork Hundred, Sussex Co., DE in c.
1850
and died in
1934
.
Nathaniel appears with his family in the
1860
De census records, age 10. In the
1870
census he is shown, age 19, with an occupation listed as "works on farm".
He married Lucy Perkins (
1853
-
1936
) and moved to Seaford, DE. This may have been the branch that lead Weslager to refer to the Jackson family as having originated in Seaford. Lucy was the daughter of Wingate and Doretor Perkins.
Nathaniel and Lucy had the following children:
Lulu Jackson (
1876
-
1962
)

Nathaniel Jackson

Preserved Primary Document • jacksonn.htm

Nathaniel Jackson was the son of Wesley Jackson and his wife, Elizabeth. He was born probably in Northwest Fork Hundred, Sussex Co., DE in c. 1850 and died in 1934. Nathaniel appears with his family in the 1860 De census records, age 10. In the 1870 census he is shown, age 19, with an occupation listed as "works on farm". He married Lucy Perkins (1853-1936) and moved to Seaford, DE. This may have been the branch that lead Weslager to refer to the Jackson family as having originated in Seaford. Lucy was the daughter of Wingate and Doretor Perkins. Nathaniel and Lucy had the following children: Lulu Jackson (1876-1962) Clarence Jackson (1878-1941) married Ellen S.
